items.title: PolyReader: an agentic LLM pipeline for extracting structured data from unstructured polymer scientific literature
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning for polymer design requires structured, sample-level records linking polymer identity, synthesis, composition, molecular-weight characteristics, processing conditions, and measured properties. Yet decades of polymer data remain dispersed across the texts, tables, figures, and supporting information of the literature, where individual values are often separated from the samples and experimental context they describe. Here we introduce PolyReader, an LLM agent for provenance-aware extraction of polymer data from scientific papers. Rather than treating a paper as a single block of text, PolyReader represents the manuscript and supporting information as navigable hierarchical section trees. The agent surveys this structure, selectively reads relevant pages, follows cross-references between documents, and integrates dispersed evidence into schema-validated, per-sample records. The resulting extracted fields are thus linked to its source document and page. On a benchmark of 42 polymer papers evaluated by trained annotators, PolyReader achieved F1 scores of 0.92–0.96 across 11 property categories, with comparable performance across three LLM models. Holding the LLM model, parsed document representation, and output schema fixed, PolyReader improved F1 by 13–17 points over single-pass prompting. These results show that reliable polymer-data extraction depends not only on recognizing individual values, but on reconstructing the sample-level relationships distributed throughout a paper. PolyReader produces records that are directly auditable against the primary literature, providing a scalable foundation for constructing traceable polymer datasets for machine learning. The extraction pipeline and benchmark annotations are released for reuse in the community.

items.title: BOTANIC-1: a series of long-context plant genomic foundation models in the agentic era
items.abstract_or_text: The development of climate-resilient crops would be greatly accelerated by models able to reason directly over plant genomic sequences and to pinpoint trait-associated regions or loci. Anticipating the impact of DNA base changes (variants) remains challenging, and understanding regulatory mechanisms is still an active area of research. Through self-supervised training on unannotated genomic data, genomic language models (gLMs) can learn DNA syntax and grammar that go beyond current annotations, thus complementing standard bioinformatics analyses that rely on rules established by decades of genomics research. Here we present our agent-powered Model Factory and its first outputs: the Botanic1 family of gLMs designed for plant research, which operates reliably on sequences from hundreds of base pairs up to 128 kbp. These models outperform all generalist and plant-specific gLMs (as well as specialised baselines) on one of the largest sets of plant genomics evaluation tasks reported to date, at a much smaller budget than concurrent models. Mechanistic interpretability analysis identifies features associated with biologically meaningful sequence properties including coding region boundaries and splice site motifs, demonstrating that these models are a source of biological insight beyond their benchmark performance. Finally, because a gLM only becomes practically useful when embedded in a broader workflow, we integrate Botanic1 as a specialised genomic layer callable by a generalist large language model (LLM) agent, illustrating how such hybrid systems could accelerate plant biology research. To support the plant genomics research community, we release the four Botanic1 models, their pre-training corpus and the trained sparse autoencoder for research use at https://huggingface.co/spaces/living-models/botanic1-report.

items.title: DEEP LEARNING HELMHOLTZ ENERGIES FOR THERMODYNAMIC PROPERTY PREDICTION
items.abstract_or_text: Based on SAFT equations of state (EoS), we propose a physics informed neural network that learns the residual Helmholtz free energy, yielding pressure, chemical potentials, entropy, and phase equilibria by automatic differentiation. Transport properties are connected through additional relations. The model can be pretrained on synthetic EoS data and fine-tuned with heterogeneous experimental data. The model operates on logarithmic scale and is designed to stabilize learning properties that span several orders of magnitude between phases, state points, and molecules. A differentiable transport model further allows viscosity and self-diffusion data to learn the temperature derivative of the Helmholtz energy during fine-tuning. As a proof of concept, we fine-tune the model to experimental temperature–pressure–density, viscosity, and self-diffusion data for water. Despite using only state point information and transport data for this single, particularly challenging fluid, the model predicts vapor pressure, vaporization enthalpy, density and entropy anomalies, and the critical temperature without direct exposure to these properties during fine-tuning. This demonstrates that jointly learning Helmholtz energies and transport coefficients is viable and beneficial. We argue that such Helmholtz energy centered, data driven deep learning models provide an alternative to the current proliferation of isolated, single property machine learning solutions. Generalization to unseen molecules and a fixed functional mode with optimized molecule representation parameters are also demonstrated.
items.summary_zh: 构建以 SAFT 状态方程为约束的物理信息神经网络，学习残余 Helmholtz 自由能，并由自动微分统一预测热力学、相平衡及部分输运性质。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法尝试避免为每一种性质单独建立模型，并以水的温压密度、黏度和自扩散实验数据进行微调。摘要所述的实证重点仍是单一高难流体，对未知分子的普适性需要进一步独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 SAFT 状态方程（EoS），我们提出一种物理信息神经网络，用于学习残余 Helmholtz 自由能，并通过自动微分得到压力、化学势、熵和相平衡。输运性质通过附加关系相连。该模型可以先在合成 EoS 数据上预训练，再用异质实验数据微调。模型在对数尺度上运行，旨在稳定学习跨越多个数量级的性质，这些性质跨越不同相、状态点和分子。一个可微的输运模型还使黏度和自扩散数据能够在微调期间学习 Helmholtz 能的温度导数。作为概念验证，我们使用水的实验温度—压力—密度、黏度和自扩散数据对模型进行微调。尽管微调时只使用了状态点信息和这一种特别具挑战性流体的输运数据，该模型仍能在未直接接触这些性质的情况下预测蒸气压、汽化焓、密度和熵异常以及临界温度。这表明联合学习 Helmholtz 能和输运系数是可行且有益的。我们认为，这类以 Helmholtz 能为中心、数据驱动的深度学习模型，为目前不断增多的彼此孤立的单性质机器学习方案提供了替代选择。文中还展示了对未知分子的泛化，以及具有优化分子表示参数的固定功能模式。

items.title: Comparative Evaluation of Graph Neural Networks for Molecular Lipophilicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting molecular properties is a central challenge in cheminformatics and plays a critical role in drug discovery and materials science. Lipophilicity, which describes the partitioning of a molecule between lipid and aqueous environments, is a key physicochemical property influencing drug behavior. Although quantum mechanical methods can provide accurate predictions, they are often computationally demanding. In contrast, large experimental databases can be leveraged to train data-driven models such as graph neural networks (GNNs), which learn molecular representations directly from chemical structures. In this study, we compare four GNN architectures—graph convolutional networks (GCN), graph isomorphism networks (GIN), Graph Sample and AggregatE (GraphSAGE), and Attentive Fingerprint (Attentive FP)—for predicting lipophilicity using both regression and classification approaches. The models are evaluated on a benchmark dataset under consistent preprocessing, optimization, and training conditions. Our results show that the Attentive FP model consistently outperforms the other architectures, yielding improved predictive accuracy across both tasks. We further examine the impact of outlier removal during preprocessing, observing reduced prediction errors and improved robustness. These findings provide insight into the capabilities of representative GNN models for molecular lipophilicity prediction.
items.summary_zh: 在统一预处理、优化和训练条件下，对 GCN、GIN、GraphSAGE 与 Attentive FP 的分子脂溶性回归和分类性能进行比较，报告 Attentive FP 持续最佳。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 脂溶性是药物暴露和材料性质的基础变量，统一条件下的架构比较具有基线参考价值。摘要未说明外部或骨架切分验证，且移除离群值带来的提升需要警惕潜在的数据筛选偏差。
items.abstract_zh: 预测分子性质是化学信息学的核心挑战，并在药物发现和材料科学中发挥关键作用。脂溶性描述分子在脂质和水环境之间的分配，是影响药物行为的关键物理化学性质。尽管量子力学方法可以提供准确预测，但它们通常计算成本高。相比之下，可利用大型实验数据库训练数据驱动模型，例如直接从化学结构学习分子表示的图神经网络（GNN）。本研究比较四种 GNN 架构——图卷积网络（GCN）、图同构网络（GIN）、Graph Sample and AggregatE（GraphSAGE）和 Attentive Fingerprint（Attentive FP）——用于脂溶性预测，同时采用回归和分类方法。模型在一致的预处理、优化和训练条件下于一个基准数据集上评估。结果显示，Attentive FP 模型持续优于其他架构，在两项任务中均产生更高的预测准确度。我们还考察了预处理期间移除离群值的影响，观察到预测误差降低、稳健性提高。这些发现为代表性 GNN 模型预测分子脂溶性的能力提供了见解。

items.title: Generative machine learning unlocks the first proteome-wide image of human cells
items.abstract_or_text: The spatial organization of proteins within cells governs virtually all cellular functions, yet current imaging can simultaneously visualize only tens of proteins, orders of magnitude below the thousands populating a single human cell. Here we present ProtiCelli, a deep generative model that simulates microscopy images for 12,800 human proteins from just three cellular landmark stains. Trained on 1.23 million Human Protein Atlas images, ProtiCelli outperforms existing methods in reconstruction accuracy and textural fidelity, and generalizes to unseen cell types and drug perturbations. Simulated images preserve hierarchical subcellular organization, recapitulate known protein protein interaction landscapes, and resolve compartment-specific functions of moonlighting proteins at single cell resolution. Remarkably, the model infers drug-induced changes in protein expression and localization from cell morphology alone, predicts cell cycle stage without dedicated markers, and enables unsupervised segmentation of subcellular compartments and spatial decomposition of gene sets into functional regions. We leverage ProtiCelli to generate Proteome2Cell, a dataset of 30.7 million simulated images spanning 2,400 virtual cells across 12 human cell lines, enabling hierarchical single-cell models that distinguish conserved from dynamic protein architectures. Integrated into the Human Protein Atlas, Proteome2Cell democratizes exploration of these virtual cells. By computationally bridging the experimental scalability gap, ProtiCelli establishes a foundation for spatial virtual cell modeling.
items.summary_zh: ProtiCelli 以三个细胞地标染色为条件，从 Human Protein Atlas 图像学习生成 12,800 种人类蛋白的虚拟显微图像，并发布 Proteome2Cell 虚拟细胞资源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将空间蛋白组图像生成扩展到蛋白质组尺度，并报告了跨细胞类型和药物扰动的泛化；其功能性推断仍属于预印本中的计算结果。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质在细胞内的空间组织几乎支配所有细胞功能，然而当前成像只能同时可视化几十种蛋白，比单个人细胞中存在的数千种蛋白低几个数量级。我们在此提出 ProtiCelli，一种深度生成模型，仅凭三种细胞地标染色即可模拟 12,800 种人类蛋白的显微图像。ProtiCelli 在 123 万张 Human Protein Atlas 图像上训练，在重建准确性和纹理保真度上优于现有方法，并可泛化至未见过的细胞类型和药物扰动。模拟图像保留层级化的亚细胞组织，重现已知的蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用图谱，并在单细胞分辨率下解析多功能蛋白的区室特异性功能。值得注意的是，该模型可仅从细胞形态推断药物诱导的蛋白表达和定位变化，无需专门标记即可预测细胞周期阶段，并实现亚细胞区室的无监督分割以及将基因集空间分解为功能区域。我们利用 ProtiCelli 生成 Proteome2Cell：该数据集包含跨 12 种人类细胞系的 2,400 个虚拟细胞和 3,070 万张模拟图像，可用于构建区分保守与动态蛋白质架构的层级单细胞模型。Proteome2Cell 被整合进 Human Protein Atlas，使这些虚拟细胞的探索得以普及。通过计算方式弥合实验可扩展性缺口，ProtiCelli 为构建空间虚拟细胞模型奠定了基础。
items.author_line: Sun, H., Kahnert, K., Hansen, J. N., Leineweber, W. D., Li, M., Feng, W., Ballllosera Navarro, F., Axelsson, U., Ouyang, W., Lundberg, E.

items.title: Perturbation-Aware Neural ODE (pNODE) Learns Microbiome Dynamics from Clinical Data and Predicts Gut-Borne Bloodstream Infections in Patients Receiving Cancer Treatment
items.abstract_or_text: Disruption of the gut microbiota during cancer treatment, particularly in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation (allo-HCT), contributes to adverse clinical outcomes, including gut-borne bloodstream infections. Accurately forecasting microbial population dynamics under clinical perturbations, such as antibiotic administration, could inform treatment strategies to reduce infection risk. However, traditional models like the Generalized Lotka-Volterra (gLV), which consider only pairwise interactions with constant sign and magnitude, are limited in capturing the real-world nonlinear dynamics of multispecies microbiomes following ecosystem disturbances. Here, we introduce a perturbation-augmented Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (pNODE) framework that flexibly models microbial population dynamics in continuous time, integrating both microbial abundances and time-resolved antibiotic perturbations. Using synthetic and real clinical data from over 1,000 allo-HCT patients, we show that pNODEs outperform gLV in predictive accuracy, robustness to noise, and forecasting critical events, such as the intestinal expansion of an opportunistic pathogen. Notably, we demonstrate that running a pre-trained pNODE in generative mode to simulate prospective Enterococcus abundance trajectories from an initial sample and antibiotic timeline yields scores that accurately predict subsequent bloodstream infections in held-out cohorts, outperforming baseline and ground-truth-based predictors. Our findings demonstrate the potential of pNODEs as a next-generation tool for modeling clinical microbiome dynamics, with applications for predicting infections in immunocompromised patients hospitalized for cancer treatment.
items.summary_zh: pNODE 将微生物丰度与时间分辨的抗生素扰动纳入 Neural ODE，在超过 1,000 名 allo-HCT 患者的临床数据中预测肠源性血流感染风险相关轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把动态微生物组建模与独立留出队列的感染预测相连接，但其结果是预印本中的预测性能，尚非可直接指导治疗的临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 癌症治疗期间肠道微生物群的紊乱，特别是在异基因造血细胞移植（allo-HCT）中，会导致包括肠源性血流感染在内的不良临床结局。在抗生素给药等临床扰动下准确预测微生物种群动态，可能有助于制定降低感染风险的治疗策略。然而，传统模型如广义 Lotka–Volterra（gLV）模型仅考虑符号和大小恒定的成对相互作用，难以捕捉生态系统受扰动后多物种微生物组的真实世界非线性动态。我们在此提出扰动增强型 Neural Ordinary Differential Equation（pNODE）框架，可在连续时间中灵活建模微生物种群动态，并整合微生物丰度和时间分辨的抗生素扰动。利用合成数据和来自超过 1,000 名 allo-HCT 患者的真实临床数据，我们显示 pNODE 在预测准确性、对噪声的鲁棒性及对关键事件的预测上优于 gLV，例如机会致病菌在肠道内的扩增。值得注意的是，我们证明，以初始样本和抗生素时间线为输入，在生成模式下运行预训练 pNODE 来模拟前瞻性 Enterococcus 丰度轨迹，可产生能够准确预测留出队列后续血流感染的评分，并优于基线预测器和基于真实值的预测器。我们的发现表明，pNODE 有望成为下一代临床微生物组动态建模工具，可用于预测在接受癌症治疗住院的免疫功能低下患者中的感染。
items.author_line: Stamper, I. C., Aeria, B., Xavier, J.

items.title: Tensor-based representation learning for multi-omics integrative clustering and feature discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-omics integrative analysis provides a powerful means for elucidating complex molecular mechanisms and biological processes, yet remains challenging in effectively representing the multi-dimensional relationships inherent to multi-omics data. Here we present MIA, a tensor-based representation learning framework that preserves the multi-dimensional structure of multi-omics data for accurate sample clustering and feature discovery. Unlike existing algorithms that primarily rely on two-dimensional representations, MIA models multi-omics data as a three-dimensional tensor and integrates tensor decomposition, fuzzy c-means, and an enhanced random forest model within a unified framework for clustering and feature discovery. Benchmarking on simulated and empirical datasets demonstrates that MIA consistently outperforms representative state-of-the-art algorithms in both clustering and feature identification. Application to multiple TCGA cancer types further shows its ability to stratify samples and identify molecular features associated with clinically relevant outcomes. Specifically, in glioblastoma, MIA reveals three previously uncharacterized subtypes with distinct prognostic profiles and uncovers feature genes strongly associated with subtype identity. These genes are further linked to therapeutic response and retain discriminative power across major glioblastoma cellular populations at single-cell resolution. Collectively, our results establish MIA as a generalizable computational framework for multi-omics integrative analysis, enabling systematic molecular stratification and interpretable feature discovery across diverse biological systems.
items.summary_zh: MIA 以三维张量保留多组学维度关系，结合张量分解、模糊 c-means 与增强随机森林完成聚类和特征发现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法在模拟、经验数据和多个 TCGA 癌种上进行了比较；其与预后、治疗反应和细胞状态的联系主要是关联性结果。
items.abstract_zh: 多组学整合分析为阐明复杂分子机制和生物过程提供了有力手段，但有效表征多组学数据固有的多维关系仍具挑战。我们在此提出 MIA：一种基于张量的表征学习框架，可保留多组学数据的多维结构，用于准确的样本聚类和特征发现。不同于主要依赖二维表征的现有算法，MIA 将多组学数据建模为三维张量，并在统一框架中整合张量分解、模糊 c-means 和增强随机森林模型，用于聚类和特征发现。在模拟和经验数据集上的基准测试表明，MIA 在聚类和特征识别两方面均持续优于有代表性的最先进算法。应用于多种 TCGA 癌症类型进一步显示其能够对样本进行分层，并识别与临床相关结局有关的分子特征。具体而言，在胶质母细胞瘤中，MIA 揭示了三种此前未被表征、具有不同预后特征的亚型，并发现了与亚型身份密切相关的特征基因。这些基因还与治疗反应相关，并在主要胶质母细胞瘤细胞群中于单细胞分辨率下保持区分能力。总体而言，我们的结果将 MIA 建立为一个可泛化的多组学整合分析计算框架，可在多样生物系统中实现系统性分子分层和可解释特征发现。
items.author_line: Zhang, Y., Liu, L., Liu, Z., Liu, Q., Ma, L., Zhang, Z.

items.title: SUMOylation is a Therapeutic Vulnerability in High-risk Neuroblastoma
items.abstract_or_text: Neuroblastoma (NB) is one of the most common solid malignancies in children, and high-risk patients have poor prognosis, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic agents. The small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) is a reversible post-translational modification that regulates various protein functions, and the first-in-class SUMOylation inhibitor TAK-981 (subasumstat) is currently in clinical trials in adult cancer patients. However, the role of SUMOylation in NB pathogenesis remains poorly characterized. We show that SUMOylation-catalyzing enzymes, SAE1, SAE2, and UBE2I, are highly expressed in malignant neuroendocrine cells, and their expression correlate with poor survival in NB patients and associate with advanced stage, MYCN amplifications, and downregulation of late differentiation markers. The peripheral nervous system lineage and NB cell lines are highly sensitive to the CRISPR knockout of SAE1 and SAE2, suggesting SUMOylation as promising therapeutic target in NB. Accordingly, TAK-981-mediated inhibition of SUMOylation reduces growth of NB cells in both in vitro and in vivo models through induction of apoptosis and perturbation of differentiation-associated pathways. Sensitivity to SUMOylation inhibition is greatest in NB cells with low expression of favorable late neuroblast markers and is independent of MYCN amplification status. Moreover, TAK-981 is effective in combination with differentiation-inducing all-trans retinoic acid and the DNA methyltransferase inhibitor decitabine. Mechanistically, combination of TAK-981 and retinoic acid potently downregulates retinoic acid receptor alpha (RAR) expression, whereas inhibition of SUMOylation combined with decitabine induces a strong accumulation of DNA damage. Taken together, these findings establish SUMO pathway components as potential prognostic markers and SUMOylation as a therapeutic vulnerability in high-risk NB.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在高危神经母细胞瘤中将 SUMOylation 通路与预后、CRISPR 脆弱性和 TAK-981 的体内外抑瘤效应相联系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: CRISPR、细胞和体内模型共同支持 SUMOylation 的候选治疗脆弱性；TAK-981 在成人癌症临床试验中不等于其已在神经母细胞瘤患者中获证实。
items.abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤（NB）是儿童最常见的实体恶性肿瘤之一，高危患者预后不良，凸显了对新型治疗药物的需求。小泛素样修饰蛋白（SUMO）是一种调节多种蛋白质功能的可逆翻译后修饰，而首创 SUMOylation 抑制剂 TAK-981（subasumstat）目前正在成人癌症患者中进行临床试验。然而，SUMOylation 在 NB 发病机制中的作用仍缺乏表征。我们显示，催化 SUMOylation 的酶 SAE1、SAE2 和 UBE2I 在恶性神经内分泌细胞中高表达，其表达与 NB 患者较差生存相关，并与晚期、MYCN 扩增和晚期分化标志物下调相关。周围神经系统谱系和 NB 细胞系对 SAE1 和 SAE2 的 CRISPR 敲除高度敏感，提示 SUMOylation 是 NB 中有前景的治疗靶点。因此，TAK-981 介导的 SUMOylation 抑制可通过诱导凋亡和扰动分化相关通路，在体外和体内模型中降低 NB 细胞生长。对 SUMOylation 抑制的敏感性在低表达有利的晚期神经母细胞瘤标志物的 NB 细胞中最高，并且独立于 MYCN 扩增状态。此外，TAK-981 与诱导分化的全反式维甲酸和 DNA 甲基转移酶抑制剂 decitabine 联用有效。机制上，TAK-981 与维甲酸联用可强力下调维甲酸受体 alpha（RAR）表达，而 SUMOylation 抑制与 decitabine 联用会强烈累积 DNA 损伤。综上，这些发现将 SUMO 通路组分确立为潜在预后标志物，并将 SUMOylation 确立为高危 NB 的治疗脆弱性。

items.title: uFlowCSP: Crystal Structure Prediction using Mean flow generative models
items.abstract_or_text: Crystal structure prediction (CSP) is fundamental to computational materials discovery. Generative models including CDVAE, DiffCSP, FlowMM, and CrystalFlow learn stable-crystal distributions directly, but diffusion and flow-matching inference requires tens to thousands of sequential network evaluations per candidate. We introduce uFlowCSP, a MeanFlow-based CSP model that learns the average, rather than instantaneous, probability-flow velocity. It generates a complete structure in one to five evaluations, delivering 5x-58x faster inference with equal or better performance. A chemistry- and symmetry-aware Transformer uses canonical atom ordering, global composition, and per-token chemistry embeddings. A coarse crystal-system token is used only during training; it provides additive gains, particularly improving space-group agreement despite being absent at inference, which remains formula-only. On MP-20 with 20 candidates per target, one step matches CrystalFlow (78.38% vs. 78.34%) with 100x fewer evaluations and about 10x lower wall-clock time. Five steps reach 83.64%, exceeding CrystalFlow (78.34% at 2,000 evaluations) and DiffCSP (77.93% at about 20,000), while using 20x fewer evaluations. uFlowCSP generates 10,000 structures in 0.39-1.31 minutes, versus 6.5 for CrystalFlow and 76.1 for DiffCSP. Under CSPBench's energy-ranked top-five structure-and-space-group criterion, five-step uFlowCSP reaches 72%/72%/65% structure, space-group, and consensus match rates. CrystalFlow reaches 78%/73%/68% at 100 steps but falls to 49%/32%/31% at five. Thus, uFlowCSP improves accuracy per network evaluation, not merely peak accuracy.
items.summary_zh: uFlowCSP 以 MeanFlow 生成模型进行晶体结构预测，通过学习平均概率流速度，将一次生成所需的网络评估降至1–5次，并在 MP-20 与 CSPBench 上比较性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 晶体结构生成的推理成本是材料发现中的实际制约；摘要报告该方法以较少评估取得有竞争力或更高的匹配率。结论目前主要来自标准基准，尚未提供面向新材料的实验合成验证。
items.abstract_zh: 晶体结构预测（CSP）是计算材料发现的基础。包括 CDVAE、DiffCSP、FlowMM 和 CrystalFlow 在内的生成模型可直接学习稳定晶体分布，但扩散和流匹配推理要求每个候选进行数十至数千次连续网络评估。我们提出 uFlowCSP，一种基于 MeanFlow 的 CSP 模型，它学习平均而非瞬时的概率流速度。它可在一至五次评估中生成完整结构，实现5x–58x更快的推理，同时具有相同或更好的性能。一个具有化学和对称性认知能力的 Transformer 使用规范原子排序、全局组成和逐 token 化学嵌入。粗粒度晶系 token 仅在训练中使用；它带来叠加的增益，尤其提升空间群一致性，尽管推理时该 token 不存在，推理仍只使用化学式。在 MP-20 上每个目标生成20个候选时，单步表现与 CrystalFlow 相当（78.38% 对78.34%），但网络评估次数少100倍、壁钟时间约低10倍。五步达到83.64%，超过 CrystalFlow（2,000次评估时为78.34%）和 DiffCSP（约20,000次评估时为77.93%），同时使用的评估次数少20倍。uFlowCSP 可在0.39–1.31分钟内生成10,000个结构，而 CrystalFlow 为6.5分钟，DiffCSP 为76.1分钟。在 CSPBench 按能量排序的前五结构—空间群标准下，五步 uFlowCSP 的结构、空间群和一致性匹配率分别达到72%/72%/65%。CrystalFlow 在100步时达到78%/73%/68%，但在五步时降至49%/32%/31%。因此，uFlowCSP 提高的是每次网络评估的准确度，而不只是峰值准确度。
items.author_line: Sourin Dey, Dipannoy Das Gupta, Lai Wei, Sadman Sadeed Omee, Jianjun Hu

items.title: A Systematic Evaluation of Molecule Generation Models for De Novo Drug Design: From Benchmarks to Practical Insights
items.abstract_or_text: Molecule generation has emerged as a powerful computational tool for de novo drug design, enabling the exploration of chemical space beyond the limits of conventional virtual screening. The field has progressed rapidly, driven by advances in molecular representations, generative architectures, and target-aware modeling strategies. However, existing reviews typically address specific model families or application scenarios in isolation, rather than offering an integrated perspective on how these components collectively form a coherent generation workflow. In this review, we present a comprehensive evaluation of molecule generation models for de novo drug design, covering 82 methods across five deep generative frameworks, including recurrent neural network (RNN)- and Transformer-based models, variational autoencoders (VAEs), generative adversarial networks (GANs), flow-based models, and diffusion models. We first summarize widely used benchmarks and molecular representations, and then examine the methodological principles underlying both general and pocket-conditioned generation. A central contribution of this work is a systematic synthesis and comparative analysis of reported performance across commonly used benchmarks and evaluation metrics. We also summarize representative experimentally validated case studies. Looking ahead, we discuss future directions in standardized 3D data, interaction-aware generation, receptor flexibility, and multi-objective molecular design, with the aim of improving the reliability and experimental relevance of molecule generation. All collected benchmark resources, evaluation metrics, and model references are provided in a publicly accessible repository at https://github.com/JacklinGroup/molecule-generation-review.
items.summary_zh: 综述82种从头药物分子生成方法，覆盖五类深度生成框架、通用与口袋条件生成、基准、表示及实验验证案例，并公开汇总资源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其价值在于横向梳理模型、评测和实验相关案例，便于识别生成模型从基准走向药物发现的缺口。它是综述而非新的盲法头对头实验；综合结论受原始研究的基准与报告标准不一致限制。
items.abstract_zh: 分子生成已成为从头药物设计的强大计算工具，使得对化学空间的探索能够超越传统虚拟筛选的限制。该领域在分子表示、生成架构和靶标感知建模策略进步的推动下快速发展。然而，现有综述通常孤立地讨论特定模型家族或应用场景，而没有提供关于这些组成部分如何共同形成连贯生成工作流的整合性视角。在这篇综述中，我们对从头药物设计的分子生成模型进行全面评估，涵盖五种深度生成框架中的82种方法，包括基于循环神经网络（RNN）和 Transformer 的模型、变分自编码器（VAE）、生成对抗网络（GAN）、基于流的模型和扩散模型。我们首先概述广泛使用的基准和分子表示，随后考察通用生成和口袋条件生成背后的方法学原理。该工作的核心贡献是对常用基准与评估指标上已报告性能进行系统综合和比较分析。我们还总结了具有代表性的实验验证案例。展望未来，我们讨论标准化3D数据、相互作用感知生成、受体柔性和多目标分子设计的发展方向，旨在提高分子生成的可靠性和实验相关性。所有汇集的基准资源、评估指标和模型参考均已在公开可访问的资源库 https://github.com/JacklinGroup/molecule-generation-review 中提供。
items.author_line: Xinrui Xu, Xueer Wang, Dan Luo, Sisi Yuan, Xuan Lin

items.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
items.abstract_or_text: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting.
items.summary_zh: 在 DeepChem MoleculeNet 的 Plasma Protein Binding 数据上，比较树模型、ChemBERTa、图神经网络及后期融合，并采用 Bemis–Murcko scaffold split 衡量对未见核心的外推。
items.why_it_matters_zh: PPB 是 ADMET 决策的重要性质；该工作强调随机切分会高估泛化能力，并显示融合模型的平均表现更佳。证据来自单一公共数据集，摘要未给出外部测试集、置信区间或实验前瞻验证。
items.abstract_zh: 从想法产生到测试，药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程。科学家不会追逐所有分子创意，而会优先选择那些从合成、安全性到治疗用途都更可能成功的分子。机器学习和 AI 使研究人员能够通过预测诸如 ADMET（Absorption、Distribution、Metabolism、Excretion 和 Toxicity）等重要性质来缩小候选选择范围。本研究使用来自 DeepChem 的 MoleculeNet 的 Plasma Protein Binding（PPB）数据集，采用多个图神经网络（GNN）、ChemBERTa（一个面向分子 SMILES 字符串的语言模型）及这些模型的融合。将这些神经模型的性能与两种标准树模型——随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost——进行比较。研究没有对数据集进行随机切分，而是依据 Bemis–Murcko 骨架进行切分，将整个骨架组仅放入训练集、验证集或测试集。该研究表明，对于 PPB 数据集，GNN 和 ChemBERTa 模型优于树模型。按平均表现计，融合模型优于单独的 GNN 或仅使用 ChemBERTa 的模型。RF 模型在随机切分下的 R2 分数优于在骨架切分数据集上的结果。由于在骨架切分下，模型需要对未见核心进行预测，该任务比常规随机切分更困难。

items.title: Sex-aware Cross-tissue Regulatory Transformer Identified Sexually Dimorphic Alzheimer's Disease Risk Loci and Causal Cellular Circuit
items.abstract_or_text: Sex differences in Alzheimer's disease (AD) genetic effects and regulatory contexts remain incompletely resolved. We analyzed 449,335 European-ancestry participants using sex-stratified and genotype-by-sex models and developed STAGE-AD, a Transformer integrating molecular QTLs, epigenomic and single-cell annotations. Sex-stratified analyses identified eight female and three male genome-wide-significant signals provisionally classified as novel. Primary test-set area under the precision-recall curve was 0.895 (95% confidence interval, 0.877-0.912), decreasing to 0.751 under locus hold-out and 0.681 under APOE-region hold-out. Statistical-genetic integration in independent HUNT and MVP cohorts supported 236 genes at 106 loci. Prespecified lifetime-risk assumptions yielded liability-scale SNP heritabilities of 11.42% in females and 9.23% in males. Ablations indicated that female-biased predictions depended on glial annotations and male-biased predictions on endothelial and oligodendrocyte annotations. Eleven candidate variant-gene-tissue-cell-pathology chains were evaluated using multi-omics and neuropathological data from 579 NPAD brain donors. These findings underscore the importance of considering sex-specific genetic architectures in the study of health conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, paving the way for more targeted treatment strategies.
items.summary_zh: STAGE-AD 整合性别分层遗传分析、molecular QTL、表观组和单细胞注释，提出 AD 的性别差异风险位点及候选变异—基因—细胞链路。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 449,335 名参与者、独立 HUNT/MVP 队列和 579 例 NPAD 脑供体提供了较大规模支撑；候选链路仍是统计遗传与多组学支持的关联，不能视为已证实因果回路。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）遗传效应及调控背景中的性别差异仍未被充分解析。我们利用性别分层和基因型×性别模型分析了 449,335 名欧洲血统参与者，并开发了 STAGE-AD：一种整合 molecular QTL、表观基因组和单细胞注释的 Transformer。性别分层分析发现 8 个女性和 3 个男性全基因组显著信号，暂定为新信号。主要测试集的精确率—召回率曲线下面积为 0.895（95% 置信区间，0.877–0.912），在位点留出时降至 0.751，在 APOE 区域留出时降至 0.681。在独立 HUNT 和 MVP 队列中，统计遗传学整合支持 106 个位点上的 236 个基因。预先规定的终生风险假设给出女性 11.42%、男性 9.23% 的责任尺度 SNP 遗传力。消融实验表明，女性偏倚预测依赖胶质细胞注释，而男性偏倚预测依赖内皮细胞和少突胶质细胞注释。利用 579 名 NPAD 脑供体的多组学和神经病理学数据，评估了 11 条候选变异—基因—组织—细胞—病理链路。这些发现强调，在包括阿尔茨海默病在内的健康状况研究中考虑性别特异性遗传架构的重要性，并为更有针对性的治疗策略铺平道路。

items.title: Empirical Evaluation of Single-Cell Foundation Models for Predicting Cancer Outcomes
items.abstract_or_text: Foundation models pretrained on large-scale single-cell RNA sequencing data present a promising opportunity to advance translational cancer research. However, their utility in clinically relevant, patient-level single-cell applications remains underexplored. Here, we developed an agentic strategy to systematically evaluate twelve emerging single-cell foundation models (scFMs) and three alternative baseline approaches across seven cancer-specific tasks, including cell-type annotation, cancer subtype classification, and treatment response prediction. We assessed model performance under zero-shot, continual training, and fine-tuning conditions, conducting 1,530 supervised model-fitting runs and 200 unsupervised subsample evaluations. We found that while current scFMs excelled at certain analysis tasks, such as tumor microenvironment cell annotation, they offered limited advantages in predicting clinical and biological outcomes of cancer patients compared to simpler baseline models. These insights highlight the critical role of scFM evaluation on biologically and clinically relevant tasks for precision oncology. Beyond identifying current limitations, this assessment reveals principles that can guide future methodological innovation and the use of expanded cancer single-cell cohorts to build more biologically informed and translationally effective scFMs. The resulting agentic framework supports the autonomous discovery of emerging scFMs and facilitates their standardized integration and evaluation across cancer-related tasks.
items.summary_zh: 该研究以 1,530 次监督拟合和 200 次无监督子采样，比较 12 个单细胞基础模型及三类基线在七项癌症任务上的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其主要价值是显示单细胞基础模型在患者层面临床结局预测中未必优于简单基线，为转化场景中的评测设计提供了反证性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 在大规模单细胞 RNA 测序数据上预训练的基础模型，为推进转化癌症研究提供了很有前景的机会。然而，它们在临床相关、患者层面单细胞应用中的效用仍缺乏探索。我们在此开发了一种智能体策略，系统评估 12 个新兴单细胞基础模型（scFM）和 3 种替代基线方法，覆盖 7 项癌症特异性任务，包括细胞类型注释、癌症亚型分类和治疗反应预测。我们在零样本、持续训练和微调条件下评估模型性能，进行了 1,530 次监督模型拟合运行和 200 次无监督子样本评估。我们发现，尽管当前 scFM 在某些分析任务中表现出色，例如肿瘤微环境细胞注释，但与更简单的基线模型相比，它们在预测癌症患者临床和生物学结局方面优势有限。这些洞见突出了在生物学和临床相关任务上评估 scFM 对精准肿瘤学的重要作用。除识别当前局限外，该评估还揭示了可指导未来方法创新的原则，以及利用扩展的癌症单细胞队列构建更具生物学信息性和转化有效性的 scFM 的原则。所产生的智能体框架支持自主发现新兴 scFM，并促进其在癌症相关任务中的标准化整合和评估。
items.author_line: Roman, A., Johri, S., Conci, R., Van Allen, E., Elmarakeby, H.

items.title: BioForm-LM: Generative Design of Biologics Formulations via In-Context Learning and Physics-Informed Decoding
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Motivation: Formulation design for biologics (proteins, antibodies) is a critical bottleneck in drug development, yet remains largely manual and data-poor. Existing computational tools score or rank a fixed candidate set; no prior work generates formulation recipes de novo . Results We present BioForm-LM, a generative system for biologics formulation design combining mechanistic simulation, in-context few-shot learning, and physics-informed decoding. A mechanistic simulator encoding DLVO colloidal theory and Lumry–Eyring aggregation kinetics generates \(\:{10}^{5}\) synthetic training recipes; a small decoder-only transformer pretrained on this corpus adapts to novel proteins from 3–10 real stability measurements without gradient updates; and a distilled physics critic reranks candidates by best-of-\(\:N\) decoding. On BioFormBench — a curated benchmark of real literature-mined formulations — the model attains perfect calibration on the held-out scFv (Spearman \(\:r=1.0\), \(\:p=0.0\)) from only three in-context examples, and covers 35.3% of formulation space versus 7.5% for random sampling (\(\:4.7\times\:\)). Aggregate leave-one-protein-out recall@10 is 0.167 against 0.080 (random forest) and 0.050 (SVM). Ablations show both in-context adaptation (\(\:-67\%\) recall) and the physics critic (\(\:-33\%\)) are necessary. Availability: Code, model weights and the BioFormBench dataset are openly released (see Data and code availability). Contact: sravansaijohn@gmail.com
items.summary_zh: BioForm-LM 将 DLVO 与 Lumry–Eyring 模拟、上下文学习和物理重排序结合，用于从少量稳定性测量生成生物制剂处方。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 代码、权重和 BioFormBench 已公开，且包含消融；但关键训练语料以合成处方为主，真实蛋白配方泛化仍需更广泛实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 动机：生物制剂（蛋白质、抗体）的处方设计是药物开发中的关键瓶颈，但仍主要依赖人工且数据稀缺。现有计算工具对固定候选集合进行评分或排序；此前没有工作从头生成处方配方。结果：我们提出 BioForm-LM，一个用于生物制剂处方设计的生成系统，结合机制模拟、上下文少样本学习和物理信息解码。一个编码 DLVO 胶体理论和 Lumry–Eyring 聚集动力学的机制模拟器生成了 10^5 个合成训练处方；一个在该语料上预训练的小型仅解码器 Transformer 无需梯度更新，即可利用 3–10 个真实稳定性测量适配新蛋白；一个蒸馏物理评论器通过 best-of-N 解码对候选项重新排序。在 BioFormBench——一个从真实文献中挖掘的精选处方基准——上，该模型仅凭三个上下文示例就在留出的 scFv 上达到完美校准（Spearman r=1.0，p=0.0），并覆盖 35.3% 的处方空间，而随机采样为 7.5%（4.7×）。汇总的留一蛋白 recall@10 为 0.167，而随机森林为 0.080、SVM 为 0.050。消融显示，上下文适配（recall 下降 67%）和物理评论器（recall 下降 33%）均为必要。可用性：代码、模型权重和 BioFormBench 数据集均已公开发布（见数据和代码可用性）。联系方式：sravansaijohn@gmail.com。

items.title: Proof-Carrying Cognition: Closing the Verification Gap with Reality-Settled Reward
items.abstract_or_text: Frontier gains in language-model reasoning come from reinforcement learning on reasoning traces and are concentrated in domains with a cheap, sound verifier. We argue the field's binding constraint is the verification gap: no scalable, incorruptible reward for reasoning outside formal domains. We make four contributions. (1) Theory: in a joint-Gaussian model of best-of-N selection, verifier-gold correlation rho is the exact exchange rate between test-time compute and capability, and an unsound verifier pays a polynomial penalty N^(1/rho^2); a margin-free copula form predicts realized soundness of real LLM judges to 4% median error. (2) Demonstration: in program-synthesis testbeds with executable ground truth, including a pre-registered scaled replication, unsound verifiers lose Soundness-under-Pressure as optimization grows (0.94 to 0.32 at N=4096) while a sound verifier improves monotonically; reality-anchored settlement beats a frozen verifier under i.i.d. and adversarial pressure, driving the hacking gap from ~0.27 to ~0; soundness scales log-linearly with settled labels, with on-policy settlement ~10x more label-efficient than random labeling. With real LLM judges and unit-test execution as gold, a weak judge loses soundness under best-of-N (p<0.001), a stronger judge is more robust, and selection alone manufactures +0.53 hacking gaps from honest samples. Under real GRPO training, a frozen reward model traces the full overoptimization curve (executed reward collapses 90%) while the same model refit on a 10% settlement stream preserves 6x the executed reward. (3) Paradigm: proof-carrying cognition, where reasoning steps are typed probabilistic claims priced by a self-built world model trained only on held-out reality and settled by proper scoring rules. (4) Benchmark: we specify Soundness-under-Pressure as the headline metric for a reality-settled reasoning benchmark.
items.summary_zh: 从理论与程序合成实验分析不可靠验证器在优化压力下的失效，并提出以现实结算标签约束奖励的 proof-carrying cognition 及 Soundness-under-Pressure 指标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将“答案得分高”与“经执行验证后仍可靠”区分开来，并在可执行真值、预注册扩展复现和 GRPO 训练中报告了可检验的失真现象；其结论主要来自程序合成测试环境，不能直接外推至所有推理任务。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型推理的前沿增益来自在推理轨迹上的强化学习，且集中在具有廉价、可靠验证器的领域。我们认为，该领域的约束瓶颈是验证鸿沟：在形式化领域之外，没有可扩展且不可被操纵的推理奖励。我们作出四项贡献。(1) 理论：在 best-of-N 选择的联合高斯模型中，验证器与金标准之间的相关系数 rho 是测试时计算量与能力之间的精确兑换率；不可靠验证器会付出 N^(1/rho^2) 的多项式惩罚；一种无边际 copula 形式以 4% 的中位误差预测真实 LLM judges 的实际可靠性。(2) 展示：在具有可执行真值的程序合成测试平台中，包括一项预注册的扩展复现，随着优化程度增加，不可靠验证器的 Soundness-under-Pressure 下降（在 N=4096 时从 0.94 降至 0.32），而可靠验证器单调改善；在独立同分布和对抗压力下，以现实为锚的结算优于冻结验证器，将 hacking gap 从约 0.27 降至约 0；可靠性随已结算标签呈对数线性扩展，on-policy 结算的标签效率约为随机标注的 10 倍。以真实 LLM judges 与单元测试执行作为金标准时，弱 judge 的 best-of-N 可靠性下降（p<0.001），强 judge 更稳健，仅选择就能从诚实样本中制造 +0.53 的 hacking gap。在真实 GRPO 训练中，冻结的奖励模型呈现完整的过度优化曲线（已执行奖励下降 90%），而同一模型在 10% 结算流上重新拟合后保留 6 倍的已执行奖励。(3) 范式：proof-carrying cognition，其中推理步骤是类型化的概率性主张，由仅在留出现实数据上训练的自建世界模型定价，并由适当评分规则结算。(4) 基准：我们将 Soundness-under-Pressure 指定为以现实结算的推理基准的标题指标。

items.title: StochBench: A Domain-Specific Benchmark for Stochastic Processes in Lean
items.abstract_or_text: Leading benchmarks for formal theorem proving with large language models are small collections drawn from competition math, such as the IMO and Putnam, that poorly represent field-specific applications. We introduce StochBench, a Lean 4 benchmark of 450 graduate stochastic-processes problems at varying abstraction levels, each paired with its natural-language source. Addressing a field underrepresented in Mathlib, it covers finite and countable Markov chains, renewal processes, random walks, martingales, stopping times, queues, Brownian motion, stochastic calculus, weak convergence, and Poisson and continuous-time Markov processes. Our Opus 4.8-based agent achieves a 34.9% proof rate (157/450) under a 15-minute per-problem limit. StochBench better represents domain-specific applied mathematics while remaining challenging for advanced provers.
items.summary_zh: 发布 StochBench：覆盖随机过程的 450 题 Lean 4 形式化证明基准；基于 Opus 4.8 的智能体在每题 15 分钟限制下证明了 157 题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该基准将形式化证明评测从竞赛题扩展到研究生层级随机过程，并报告了明确题数、时限与证明率，便于后续系统复核比较。
items.abstract_zh: 现有用于大型语言模型形式定理证明的主流基准，是取自 IMO 和 Putnam 等竞赛数学的小型题集，对领域特定应用的代表性不足。我们提出 StochBench：一个包含 450 道不同抽象层次研究生随机过程题目的 Lean 4 基准；每道题均与其自然语言来源配对。该基准面向 Mathlib 中代表不足的一个领域，涵盖有限与可数 Markov 链、更新过程、随机游走、鞅、停止时、排队论、Brownian motion、随机微积分、弱收敛，以及 Poisson 和连续时间 Markov 过程。基于 Opus 4.8 的智能体在每题 15 分钟限制下取得 34.9%（157/450）的证明率。StochBench 更好地代表了领域特定的应用数学，同时仍对高级证明器构成挑战。

items.title: The Graph Fourier Transform Recasts Rouse Modes to Encode Polymer Sequence
items.abstract_or_text: Rouse modes diagonalize the polymer connectivity matrix to describe how conformational motion is distributed over structural modes, yet the chemistry distributed along that same chain is traditionally encoded through hand-crafted, system-specific descriptors. Here, we generalize Rouse modes from bead coordinates to bead identity through a Graph Fourier Transform (GFT), which projects a chemically specific sequence signal onto the eigenbasis of the polymer graph Laplacian. The correspondence is exact for the combinatorial Laplacian, and holds by close analogy for its degree-weighted normalized counterpart. GFT descriptors predict the radius of gyration of architecturally diverse coarse-grained copolymers with accuracy comparable to a bespoke graph neural network and, with only the signal redefined, resolve liquid-liquid phase separation propensity in intrinsically disordered proteins. Predictive performance degrades with the degeneracy introduced by symmetric architectures. Generalized Rouse modes thus offer an architecture-adaptive and interpretable alternative to bespoke descriptors for sequence-controlled macromolecules.
items.summary_zh: 将 Graph Fourier Transform 用于聚合物链上化学序列信号，把 Rouse modes 推广为可解释、架构自适应的描述符，并测试共聚物回转半径与无序蛋白液液相分离倾向。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 用同一图谱基底连接聚合物序列化学与链构象，且可延伸至 intrinsically disordered proteins，具有方法统一性。摘要也明确对称架构引入的简并会削弱预测，适用范围不应被高估。
items.abstract_zh: Rouse modes 通过对聚合物连接矩阵对角化，描述构象运动如何分布在结构模态中；然而，沿同一条链分布的化学性质传统上是通过手工构建、体系特异性的描述符编码的。本文将 Rouse modes 从珠粒坐标推广至珠粒身份，采用 Graph Fourier Transform（GFT）把化学特异性序列信号投影到聚合物图 Laplacian 的本征基上。对于组合 Laplacian，这一对应关系是精确的；对于其按度加权的归一化对应物，也以紧密类比的方式成立。GFT 描述符预测结构多样的粗粒化共聚物回转半径的准确度可与定制图神经网络相当；只需重新定义信号，便可解析 intrinsically disordered proteins 的液液相分离倾向。预测性能会随着对称架构引入的简并而下降。因此，广义 Rouse modes 为序列控制大分子提供了一种可适应架构且可解释的替代方案，以取代定制描述符。

items.title: Learning the Language of the Microbiome with Transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Self-supervised pretraining has become central to biological machine learning, yet microbiome data remains comparatively underexplored in terms of both modeling approaches and evaluation frameworks. To address this gap, we present Atlas, a pretraining dataset of 539,308 microbiome datapoints from the MGnify database. Using Atlas, we train the Waypoint family of microbiome foundation models: a series of GPT-2 style causal language models ranging from 6M to 170M parameters. We also introduce Compass, a curated benchmark of eight predictive tasks spanning biome classification, drug-microbiome interactions, drug degradation, and infant gut development. Using this benchmark, we compare the performance of Waypoint models against classical baselines and the existing MGM foundation model. Our results show that pretraining leads to consistent and significant improvements in downstream task performance, that both dataset scale and tokenization strategy impact model quality, that pretraining is essential for achieving favorable scaling behavior and that representations learned during pretraining generalise between microbiome domains. Furthermore, pretrained transformer models begin to reliably outperform classical methods once training data exceeds roughly 10,000 examples - a threshold that is attainable for modern microbiome studies. Finally, we demonstrate that the Waypoint models achieve state-of-the-art performance among microbiome foundation models. Overall, our work highlights the importance of large-scale self-supervised pretraining in this domain and establishes Atlas, Compass, and the Waypoint models as valuable resources for the research community in this emerging field.
items.summary_zh: Atlas、Waypoint 与 Compass 分别提供 539,308 条微生物组数据、6M–170M 参数基础模型和八项任务基准，用于系统评估微生物组预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据集、模型与任务基准形成完整资源组合，并明确报告数据规模阈值；“state-of-the-art”仍是预印本作者在其基准上的比较结论。
items.abstract_zh: 自监督预训练已成为生物机器学习的核心，但就建模方法和评测框架而言，微生物组数据仍相对缺乏探索。为填补这一空白，我们提出 Atlas：一个来自 MGnify 数据库、包含 539,308 个微生物组数据点的预训练数据集。利用 Atlas，我们训练了 Waypoint 微生物组基础模型系列：一组参数规模从 6M 到 170M 的 GPT-2 风格因果语言模型。我们还提出 Compass：一个包含八项预测任务的精选基准，覆盖生物群系分类、药物—微生物组相互作用、药物降解和婴儿肠道发育。利用该基准，我们将 Waypoint 模型的表现与经典基线及现有 MGM 基础模型进行比较。结果显示，预训练可在下游任务性能上带来一致且显著的提升，数据集规模和分词策略都会影响模型质量，预训练对于获得有利的缩放行为至关重要，且预训练中学习到的表征能够在微生物组领域间泛化。此外，当训练数据超过约 10,000 个样本时，预训练 Transformer 模型开始稳定优于经典方法——这是现代微生物组研究可以达到的阈值。最后，我们表明 Waypoint 模型在微生物组基础模型中取得最先进的性能。总体而言，我们的工作突出大规模自监督预训练在该领域的重要性，并将 Atlas、Compass 和 Waypoint 模型确立为这一新兴领域研究群体的宝贵资源。

items.title: A deep generative decoder predicts microRNA expression from bulk and single-cell mRNA profiles
items.abstract_or_text: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are key post-transcriptional regulators, yet standard bulk and single-cell RNA-seq do not capture them, leaving this regulatory layer invisible in most transcriptomic data. We present miDGD, a deep generative decoder that jointly models paired mRNA and miRNA profiles through a shared latent representation, enabling miRNA expression to be predicted from mRNA alone. Trained on tumors (TCGA), healthy tissues (GTEx), and human cell lines, miDGD recovers hundreds of miRNAs in held-out tumors (mean Spearman {rho} = 0.56), captures both tissue-specific and ubiquitous miRNAs, and preserves known miRNA--target repression and host-gene co-expression. Without label supervision, its latent space separates 32 cancer types (80% accuracy). Predictions remain stable at single-cell-like sparsity and transfer across datasets--from tumors to healthy tissues and from bulk to single cells--where miDGD outperforms existing supervised and activity-inference methods. miDGD thus unlocks miRNA regulation in the vast body of existing mRNA-only data, including single-cell datasets.
items.summary_zh: miDGD 从配对 mRNA/miRNA 数据学习共享潜变量，可由 bulk 或单细胞 mRNA 预测 miRNA 表达并跨数据集迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法有望让既有 mRNA-only 数据获得 miRNA 层面的计算读出，但预测表达不能替代直接 miRNA 测量或证明调控因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: microRNA（miRNA）是关键的转录后调控因子，但标准 bulk 和单细胞 RNA-seq 无法捕获它们，使这一调控层在大多数转录组数据中不可见。我们提出 miDGD：一种深度生成解码器，通过共享潜在表征联合建模配对的 mRNA 和 miRNA 图谱，从而能够仅从 mRNA 预测 miRNA 表达。miDGD 在肿瘤（TCGA）、健康组织（GTEx）和人类细胞系上训练，可在留出肿瘤中恢复数百个 miRNA（平均 Spearman {rho} = 0.56），捕获组织特异性和普遍存在的 miRNA，并保留已知 miRNA--靶标抑制和宿主基因共表达。无需标签监督，其潜在空间可分离 32 种癌症类型（80% 准确率）。预测在单细胞样稀疏性下保持稳定，并可跨数据集迁移——从肿瘤到健康组织、从 bulk 到单细胞——在这些场景中 miDGD 优于现有监督方法和活性推断方法。因此，miDGD 在大量现有的仅 mRNA 数据中，包括单细胞数据集，开启了 miRNA 调控的研究。

items.title: Generative Language Modeling for Antibody CDR Grafting and Alignment-driven De Novo Design
items.abstract_or_text: Antibodies recognise their targets through hypervariable complementarity-determining regions (CDRs), which are interleaved with conserved frameworks in sequence space, making de novo CDR design an infilling problem. Autoregressive models generate residues left-to-right, which precludes full framework context during CDR generation and conflates framework and CDR likelihoods, leaving no natural prompt-response interface for feedback to steer generation. We present GenCDR, a family of LLaMa-based autoregressive language models that read all frameworks as a conditioning prompt and generate all CDRs jointly as a variable-length response, making CDR likelihoods a clean, separable target for reward attribution. The family comprises IgGenCDR, p-IgGenCDR, and NanoGenCDR, trained on unpaired, paired, and nanobody chains, respectively. GenCDR achieves the highest CDR recovery among autoregressive models and produces natural, diverse, human-like CDRs whose likelihoods correlate with fitness and developability assays. The prompt-response boundary also enables principled alignment: reward signals for binding affinity, expression, or developability can be composed to steer CDR generation. Over four rounds of alignment against antibody-antigen co-folding and developability objectives, we find that NanoGenCDR, which uses no explicit antigen encoding, can reach in silico structural interface metrics competitive with those of a structure-conditioned diffusion pipeline at roughly half the sampling budget, with more natural, developable designs. The same interface can be extended to integrate experimental feedback, opening a path to closed-loop antibody de novo design.
items.summary_zh: GenCDR 以全框架为提示、联合生成可变长度 CDR，并通过对齐奖励整合亲和力、表达和可开发性目标。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该提示—响应界面为抗体序列生成提供可组合优化路径；摘要所述界面指标仍为 in silico 结果，尚不等同于实验结合或可开发性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 抗体通过高变互补决定区（CDR）识别靶标；在序列空间中，CDR 与保守框架交错，因此从头 CDR 设计是一个填充问题。自回归模型从左至右生成残基，这使得在 CDR 生成期间无法获得完整框架上下文，并混淆框架和 CDR 似然，因而没有天然的提示—响应接口来让反馈引导生成。我们提出 GenCDR：一组基于 LLaMa 的自回归语言模型，以所有框架作为条件提示，并将所有 CDR 作为可变长度响应联合生成，使 CDR 似然成为可用于奖励归因的清晰、可分离目标。该系列包括分别在未配对链、配对链和纳米抗体链上训练的 IgGenCDR、p-IgGenCDR 和 NanoGenCDR。GenCDR 在自回归模型中实现最高的 CDR 恢复率，并生成自然、多样、类人 CDR，其似然与适应度和可开发性测定相关。提示—响应边界还支持有原则的对齐：可组合针对结合亲和力、表达或可开发性的奖励信号，以引导 CDR 生成。在针对抗体—抗原共折叠和可开发性目标进行四轮对齐后，我们发现，不使用显式抗原编码的 NanoGenCDR，可在大约一半采样预算下达到与结构条件扩散流水线具有竞争力的计算结构界面指标，并产生更自然、更具可开发性的设计。同一接口可扩展以整合实验反馈，为闭环抗体从头设计开辟路径。

items.title: Machine Learning Optimization of Polymeric Complex Coacervate Micelles Reveals Cell-Type-Specific Formulations for Enhanced mRNA Delivery
items.abstract_or_text: The cell-type dependent transfection heterogeneity of polymeric mRNA delivery remains a fundamental barrier to their broad translation. The field has historically addressed this by optimizing the cationic component itself, refining amine identity, density, and block architecture to maximize transfection. Even highly optimized cationic carriers, however, still transfect some cell types well and others poorly, because no single cation chemistry can simultaneously match the internalization and cytoplasmic trafficking biology of every target. Rather than seeking a universally optimal carrier chemistry, we instead sought a tunable formulation framework capable of adapting charge balance and interfacial properties across distinct cellular environments. Here, we report a multicomponent complex coacervate micelle platform in which a cationic oligoamine-functionalized A7 amphiphile , an anionic poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (CEA) homopolymer, and a neutral-anionic poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(carboxyethyl acrylate) (PEG-CEA) diblock are co-assembled into a single carrier, with the anionic and stealth components associating electrostatically with the cationic micelle as external corona species. Closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimization (qNEHVI) of the A7/CEA/PEG-CEA formulation simplex over three rounds in HEK293T cells identified a productive ternary region that increased effective efficiency (delivery × viability) from ~0.35 for the A7 homomicelle to approximately 0.8 for the best mixed micelle. The resulting 35-formulation library was directly screened across six additional cell types (A549, MDA-MB-231, HuH7, OVCAR8, HEK001, and primary patient-derived fibroblasts), where the best mixed micelle outperformed all polymer-based commercial reagents in every cell line. The winning composition was different in every cell line, establishing tunability rather than a single fixed optimum as the platform's central practical advantage. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) attribution on Random Forest surrogates then converted these cell-line-specific winners into transferable design rules, identifying which formulation descriptors drive delivery and viability in each cellular context. Together, this work delivers a tunable polymeric transfection platform and a framework for cell-type-aware design of mRNA carriers.
items.summary_zh: 利用闭环多目标贝叶斯优化，研究构建并筛选三组分聚合物复合凝聚层胶束，使 mRNA 递送配方可随细胞类型调节；35个配方在六种额外细胞类型中直接筛选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是少数将机器学习优化与跨细胞类型湿实验递送结果直接连接的候选，显示“可调性”可优于单一最优载体。限制是最优配方随细胞系改变，摘要未给出体内递送或长期安全性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 聚合物 mRNA 递送的细胞类型依赖性转染异质性，仍是其广泛转化的根本障碍。该领域历来通过优化阳离子组分本身来解决这一问题，改进胺的身份、密度和嵌段架构以最大化转染。可是，即使高度优化的阳离子载体，仍会对某些细胞类型转染良好、对另一些较差，因为没有任何单一阳离子化学能够同时匹配每一种靶细胞的内化与胞质转运生物学。我们没有寻求普遍最优的载体化学，而是寻求一种可调的配方框架，使其能够适应不同细胞环境下的电荷平衡与界面性质。本文报道了一个多组分复合凝聚层胶束平台：阳离子寡胺官能化 A7 两亲分子、阴离子 poly(carboxyethyl acrylate)（CEA）均聚物和中性—阴离子 poly(ethylene glycol)-b-poly(carboxyethyl acrylate)（PEG-CEA）二嵌段共组装为单一载体，其中阴离子和隐身组分作为外部冠层物种，通过静电作用与阳离子胶束结合。对 HEK293T 细胞中 A7/CEA/PEG-CEA 配方单纯形进行三轮闭环多目标贝叶斯优化（qNEHVI），确定了一个有效的三元区域：其有效效率（递送×存活率）从 A7 均胶束的约0.35提高到最佳混合胶束的约0.8。所得35种配方的文库随后在另外六种细胞类型（A549、MDA-MB-231、HuH7、OVCAR8、HEK001 和原代患者来源成纤维细胞）中直接筛选；其中最佳混合胶束在每一种细胞系中都优于全部基于聚合物的商业试剂。每种细胞系的获胜组成都不同，表明可调性而非单一固定最优值是该平台的核心实际优势。随后，随机森林代理模型的 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）归因将这些细胞系特异性的获胜配方转化为可迁移的设计规则，识别出每种细胞语境中驱动递送和存活率的配方描述符。总之，该工作提供了一个可调的聚合物转染平台，以及一个用于细胞类型感知 mRNA 载体设计的框架。

items.title: Machine learning-accelerated evolutionary Monte Carlo for rapid phase exploration of compositionally complex materials in reactive environments
items.abstract_or_text: Compositionally complex materials, e.g. high-entropy alloys/oxides, have long been of research interest for their unique mechanical and functional properties thanks to the synergistic effects between the large number of components. More recently, they have emerged as a promising platform for the development of novel heterogeneous catalysts for thermo- and electro-chemical applications. However, computational investigation of the phase stability of such catalyst materials remains challenging due to the large design space and the complex active site dynamics under reaction conditions. In this paper, we present a novel evolutionary Monte Carlo algorithm which allows fast exploration of stable compositionally-complex catalyst phases in reactive environments and can be generalized for any catalyst materials and any reaction conditions. In detail, we will showcase that this method can be used in combination with finetuned machine learning potentials for predicting bulk and surface mixing/segregating behaviors of compositionally-complex catalysts under various reaction conditions with reasonable computational cost.
items.summary_zh: 提出机器学习势加速的进化 Monte Carlo，用于在反应环境中快速探索高熵合金/氧化物等组成复杂催化材料的稳定相及表面混合—偏析行为。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直面复杂催化剂在反应条件下的组合空间和活性位动态问题，并声称可推广到不同催化材料和反应条件。摘要未提供定量基准、实验验证或适用边界，且为v4预印本，相关主张需结合全文审查。
items.abstract_zh: 组成复杂材料，例如高熵合金/氧化物，因大量组分之间的协同效应而具有独特的机械和功能性质，长期以来一直受到研究关注。近来，它们已成为开发用于热化学和电化学应用的新型多相催化剂的有前景平台。然而，由于庞大的设计空间以及反应条件下复杂的活性位动态，对这类催化材料相稳定性的计算研究仍具挑战性。本文提出一种新的进化 Monte Carlo 算法，可在反应环境中快速探索稳定的组成复杂催化剂相，并可推广至任何催化材料和任何反应条件。具体而言，我们将展示，该方法可结合微调的机器学习势，以合理的计算成本预测不同反应条件下组成复杂催化剂的体相和表面混合/偏析行为。

items.title: Reliable Machine Learning for DPPH Antioxidant QSAR: Scaffold- and Study-Aware Validation with an Out-of-Domain Sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly Case Study
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learning QSAR models can prioritize antioxidant compounds, but apparent accuracy depends strongly on how chemical data are partitioned for validation. This study develops a reproducible DPPH antioxidant QSAR workflow using 1,891 curated molecules from a public 30 min DPPH dataset. Molecular structures were represented by nine RDKit physicochemical descriptors and 2,048-bit Morgan fingerprints (radius 2), giving 2,057 combined features.Random Forest regression was evaluated as the primary model,with Extra Trees as an independent ensemble comparator.Random Forest achieved mean R-squared = 0.712 and MAE = 0.297 pIC50 units under random five-fold cross-validation, but performance decreased to R-squared = 0.447 and MAE = 0.433 under Bemis-Murcko scaffold-aware validation, and to R-squared = 0.124 and MAE = 0.545 under DOI-grouped validation. In an internal held-out set, molecules with scaffolds represented during training performed better than those with unseen scaffolds(R-squared=0.824 versus 0.580).Nearest-neighbour Morgan Tanimoto analysis further separated structurally supported predictions from extrapolation: inside-domain molecules achieved R-squared = 0.830, whereas outside-domain performance was R- squared =-0.031. The workflow was then applied to two experimentally investigated sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly derivatives. Both had low maximum Tanimoto similarity(0.364 and 0.333), unseen scaffolds,and were overpredicted by approximately one pIC50 unit.The results show that random-split performance alone is insufficient for judging DPPH-QSAR reliability and that chemically informed validation and applicability-domain analysis are necessary when predictions are extended to structurally novel compounds.
items.summary_zh: 以1,891个经整理的 DPPH 分子建立随机森林 QSAR，并通过骨架、DOI 分组和适用域分析量化验证切分造成的性能落差，再以两种 sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly 衍生物作域外案例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作直接展示随机切分的高分会掩盖化学外推失败，是药物性质 QSAR 验证的实用反例。其结果限定于30 min DPPH 数据、所用描述符和随机森林模型，不能据此推广至其他抗氧化测定或新骨架。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习 QSAR 模型可以用于抗氧化化合物的优先排序，但表观准确度强烈依赖于化学数据如何划分用于验证。本研究使用来自公开30 min DPPH 数据集的1,891个经整理分子，开发了一个可复现的 DPPH 抗氧化 QSAR 工作流。分子结构由九个 RDKit 物理化学描述符和2,048位 Morgan 指纹（半径2）表示，共得到2,057个组合特征。以随机森林回归作为主要模型，并以 Extra Trees 作为独立的集成比较器。随机森林在随机五折交叉验证下取得平均 R-squared = 0.712 和 MAE = 0.297 pIC50 units，但在 Bemis-Murcko 骨架感知验证下性能降至 R-squared = 0.447 和 MAE = 0.433，在按 DOI 分组的验证下则降至 R-squared = 0.124 和 MAE = 0.545。在内部留出集上，训练中具有已出现骨架的分子表现优于具有未见骨架的分子（R-squared=0.824 对0.580）。最近邻 Morgan Tanimoto 分析进一步将具有结构支持的预测与外推区分开：域内分子达到 R-squared = 0.830，而域外性能为 R-squared = -0.031。随后，该工作流应用于两个经实验研究的 sulfonamide-Tyr-Gly 衍生物。二者的最大 Tanimoto 相似度都很低（0.364 和0.333），具有未见骨架，并且被过度预测约一个 pIC50 unit。结果表明，仅凭随机切分性能不足以判断 DPPH-QSAR 的可靠性；当预测扩展至结构新颖的化合物时，化学信息驱动的验证和适用域分析是必要的。

items.title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Plane geometry remains a significant challenge in AI, requiring the integration of visual perception and mathematical reasoning. While Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) naturally handle visuo-linguistic inputs, they are often computationally intensive and opaque. We demonstrate that a pure Large Language Model (LLM), when equipped with specialized modules, can rival state-of-the-art LMMs on complex geometry problems. Our framework integrates a Geometric Vision Parser, which translates diagrams into symbolic form, with a Symbolic Solver that performs formal deductions, thereby mitigating hallucinations and promoting interpretable reasoning. To enable rigorous evaluation, we curate a benchmark of challenging problems from the 2025 Chinese Zhongkao examinations, ensuring data novelty and testing deeper deductive skills. Experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves performance comparable to Gemini 2.5 Pro while delivering clearer, human-like solutions.
items.summary_zh: 提出将几何图解析为符号表示、再由 Symbolic Solver 进行形式演绎的框架，并以 2025 年中国中考几何难题评测其表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把视觉几何题转为可检查的符号推导，提供了比端到端生成更明确的验证接口；但与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的可比性是作者报告，摘要未提供具体分数。
items.abstract_zh: 平面几何仍是 AI 面临的一项重要挑战，需要整合视觉感知与数学推理。尽管 Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) 能够自然处理视觉—语言输入，但它们往往计算开销大且不透明。我们表明，配备专门模块的纯 Large Language Model (LLM) 可以在复杂几何问题上与最先进的 LMMs 相媲美。我们的框架将把图示转换为符号形式的 Geometric Vision Parser，与执行形式演绎的 Symbolic Solver 相结合，从而减轻幻觉并促进可解释推理。为实现严格评测，我们构建了一个由 2025 年中国中考难题组成的基准，以保证数据新颖性并检验更深层的演绎技能。实验表明，所提方法的表现可与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 相比，同时给出更清晰、更接近人类的解答。

items.title: TSBench: A physics-grounded benchmark for evaluating LLM understanding of chemical reaction mechanisms
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding a chemical reaction requires mapping a symbolic reactant-product description onto the three-dimensional pathway through which atoms rearrange, yet chemistry benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) largely probe factual knowledge and text-based reasoning. Here we introduce TSBench, a benchmark in which an LLM agent uses structure-editing tools to construct three-dimensional transition-state (TS) guesses verified by an automated quantum-chemical pipeline, yielding a physics-grounded pass/fail verdict. Across 546 evaluations of seven frontier LLMs on 78 elementary reactions, the aggregate success rate rose from 50.4% to 66.8% under diagnosis-driven revision; the best models approached 90% on the simplest reactions, yet performance dropped sharply with mechanistic complexity. Most failed attempts produced locally plausible saddle points whose reaction paths led to the wrong reactant-product pair, revealing local geometric intuition without a robust grasp of the global reaction coordinate. TSBench establishes a mechanism-level yardstick for LLM agents in mechanism-sensitive tasks such as synthesis planning and autonomous experimentation.
items.summary_zh: TSBench 让 LLM 代理借助结构编辑工具构造过渡态猜测，并用自动量子化学流程按反应路径作物理判定，从而测量其对反应机理的理解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把化学机制能力从文本问答推进到可验证的三维反应路径任务，并报告了546次、覆盖78个基元反应的评测。需注意，任务集中于基元反应，复杂机制上的显著性能下降提示不能直接外推至真实合成规划。
items.abstract_zh: 理解一个化学反应，需要将符号化的反应物—产物描述映射到原子重排所经过的三维路径；然而，大语言模型（LLM）的化学基准主要考察事实知识和基于文本的推理。本文提出 TSBench：在该基准中，LLM 代理使用结构编辑工具构建三维过渡态（TS）猜测，再由自动化量子化学流程验证，给出基于物理的通过/失败判定。在对78个基元反应中7个前沿 LLM 进行的546次评估里，在诊断驱动的修订下，汇总成功率从50.4%升至66.8%；最佳模型在最简单反应上的表现接近90%，但其性能随机理复杂度增加而急剧下降。大多数失败尝试产生了局部看来合理的鞍点，但其反应路径通向错误的反应物—产物对，这揭示了局部几何直觉，却没有对全局反应坐标的稳健理解。TSBench 为合成规划和自主实验等对机理敏感的任务建立了机制层面的 LLM 代理标尺。

items.title: PocketVE: Stable and Property-Guided Structure-Based Drug Design with Variance-Exploding Diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Protein-conditioned 3D molecule generation is a central challenge in structure-based drug design, requiring a balance between pocket compatibility, molecular properties, and physical geometry. We propose PocketVE, a protein-pocket-conditioned variance-exploding (VE) diffusion framework that couples stable coordinate denoising with inference-time property guidance. Specifically, PocketVE combines an EDM-style training and sampling setup for 3D denoising, classifier-free guidance for multi-property steering without external property classifiers, and adaptive protein perturbation as a training-time pocket regularizer. Evaluated on CrossDocked2020 under the GenBench3D protocol, PocketVE improves Valid_{3D} from 58.6 to 80.6 and reduces strain energy from 457.4 to 127.9 relative to its TAGMol architectural baseline, while retaining competitive docking and molecular-property scores under moderate guidance. A guidance-scale study shows that moderate guidance gives a favorable balance between target-related objectives and geometric quality, whereas stronger guidance can degrade geometry and distributional fidelity. Pocket-permutation and PoseCheck diagnostics further support pocket-specific spatial compatibility with reduced steric conflicts. Overall, the results suggest that geometric stability and inference-time property guidance should be considered as coupled design objectives.
items.summary_zh: PocketVE 是蛋白口袋条件的 VE 扩散分子生成框架，结合稳定坐标去噪、无分类器多性质引导及蛋白扰动正则化，并在 CrossDocked2020/GenBench3D 上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将口袋适配、性质控制和三维几何质量作为耦合目标，摘要给出相对 TAGMol 的明确几何指标改善及诊断。证据仍局限于计算基准和对接/构象代理指标，未报告合成或生物活性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质条件的3D分子生成是结构基础药物设计的核心挑战，需要在口袋相容性、分子性质和物理几何之间取得平衡。我们提出 PocketVE，一种蛋白口袋条件的方差爆炸（VE）扩散框架，将稳定的坐标去噪与推理时性质引导相结合。具体而言，PocketVE 将用于3D去噪的 EDM 风格训练和采样设置、无需外部性质分类器即可进行多性质引导的无分类器引导，以及作为训练时口袋正则化器的自适应蛋白扰动结合起来。在 CrossDocked2020 上按照 GenBench3D 协议评估时，PocketVE 相对于其 TAGMol 架构基线，将 Valid_{3D} 从58.6提高至80.6，并将应变能从457.4降至127.9；同时在中等引导下保持有竞争力的对接和分子性质分数。引导尺度研究显示，中等引导在靶标相关目标与几何质量之间提供有利平衡，而更强引导会降低几何和分布保真度。口袋置换和 PoseCheck 诊断进一步支持其具备口袋特异性的空间相容性，并具有更少的空间位阻冲突。总体而言，结果表明几何稳定性与推理时性质引导应被视为耦合的设计目标。

items.title: Structure-Informed Bayesian Inference of Anomalous Transport and Hidden Molecular Trapping in Amorphous Media
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular diffusion in fluctuating amorphous and macromolecular media governs key transport processes across soft-matter physics, energy storage, and biological membranes. Extracting localized trapping states from single-particle tracking trajectories remains a fundamental challenge; because thermal structural breathing continuously reconfigures pore boundaries, conventional geometric algorithms suffer from severe systematic biases, erroneously merging distinct localized states during cyclic molecular returns. Here, we address this deadlock by shifting the paradigm from local geometric recurrence to a structure-informed Bayesian regularization. Leveraging discrete Morse theory, we extract the time-invariant topological skeleton of the fluctuating host matrix to construct robust, gas-specific physical priors that account for individual molecular dimensions. Trajectory steps are sequentially partitioned via a two-stage probabilistic refinement that dynamically adapts to the transport landscape. Benchmarked against a rigorous environment where synthetic particles explore the actual interconnected matrix graph, our approach eliminates systemic biases, restricting macroscopic trapping parameter deviations to just a few percent under optimal linear O(N) computational scaling. Applied to hydrogen and methane transport within a type-I kerogen matrix, serving as a prototype for highly tortuous, flexible macromolecular networks, the method successfully decodes the hidden microscopic mechanisms of confined diffusion. To ensure immediate broad impact, the documented open-source code and data are made publicly available, offering an accessible strategy readily adaptable to a broad spectrum of tracking phenomena, from ion transport in battery polymers to protein trafficking within cellular environments.
items.summary_zh: 以离散 Morse 理论提取波动无定形宿主的拓扑骨架，并用结构信息贝叶斯正则化分割单粒子轨迹，推断隐蔽分子俘获与异常输运机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法把轨迹局部几何复现转化为带物理先验的概率推断，面向电池聚合物、软物质与膜输运具有潜在通用性。其宏观偏差结论主要来自合成粒子基准；对 kerogen 中 H2/CH4 的应用仍需更广泛实验核验。
items.abstract_zh: 波动的无定形和大分子介质中的分子扩散，支配着软物质物理、储能和生物膜中的关键输运过程。从单粒子追踪轨迹中提取局域俘获态仍是一项基础挑战；由于热致结构呼吸持续重构孔边界，传统几何算法遭受严重系统偏差，会在分子周期性返回时错误合并不同的局域态。本文通过从局部几何复现转向结构信息驱动的贝叶斯正则化来解决这一僵局。借助离散 Morse 理论，我们提取波动宿主基质的时间不变拓扑骨架，以构建稳健、针对气体种类的物理先验，从而计及单个分子的尺寸。轨迹步长通过两阶段概率细化进行序贯划分，并动态适应输运景观。在一个严格的环境中进行基准测试时，合成粒子探索实际互连基质图，我们的方法消除了系统偏差，并在最优线性 O(N) 计算扩展性下，将宏观俘获参数偏差限制在仅几个百分点。该方法应用于作为高度曲折、柔性大分子网络原型的 I 型干酪根基质内氢和甲烷输运，成功解析了受限扩散的隐蔽微观机制。为确保即时且广泛的影响，文档化的开源代码和数据已公开提供，给出一种易于应用的策略，可适配从电池聚合物中的离子输运到细胞环境内蛋白质转运等广泛追踪现象。
items.author_line: Andrey Ananev, Maria Potapova, Nikolay Kondratyuk, Timur Vostroknutov, Aleksey Khlyupin

items.title: Predicting directional flexibility in proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting protein dynamics is a long-standing problem in computational structural biology. Often, protein function critically depends on local directed motions, such as hinge movements, catalytic loop rearrangements and domain reorientations, which can be characterized by directional flexibility and correlated structural motions of the protein backbone. While Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations provide an established but often prohibitively expensive approach, recent deep generative models aim to reduce this cost by directly predicting conformational ensembles, emulating MD. However, due to their large size and the need to generate several states until the derived dynamical properties converge, these models remain expensive. In this work, we propose BackFlip-2: a fast SE(3)-equivariant graph neural network trained to directly predict dynamical descriptors, such as directional backbone flexibility and pairwise dynamic correlations, from an equilibrium structure. In a series of experiments, we show that our model matches the accuracy of substantially larger ensemble generation models while being orders of magnitude faster, and demonstrate that the proposed equivariant architecture is especially well-suited for capturing anisotropic motions in proteins. BackFlip-2 model weights, training and inference code are available at https://github.com/graeter-group/backflip.
items.summary_zh: BackFlip-2 是由平衡结构直接预测主链方向柔性及残基对动态相关性的 SE(3)-等变图神经网络，旨在替代昂贵的构象集合生成与 MD。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方向性柔性对应铰链、催化环和结构域重排等功能运动；摘要称其以更低成本达到大型集合模型的准确度，并公开代码和权重。该比较针对计算动力学描述符，尚不能替代针对具体体系的实验动态学验证。
items.abstract_zh: 预测蛋白质动力学是计算结构生物学中长期存在的问题。蛋白质功能常常关键依赖于局部定向运动，例如铰链运动、催化环重排和结构域重新定向；这些运动可由蛋白质骨架的方向性柔性和相关结构运动表征。尽管分子动力学（MD）模拟是一种成熟但通常计算成本高昂的方法，近期的深度生成模型试图通过直接预测构象集合来降低这一成本，从而模拟 MD。然而，由于这些模型规模很大，且需要生成多个状态直至导出的动力学性质收敛，它们仍然代价高昂。在这项工作中，我们提出 BackFlip-2：一种快速的 SE(3)-等变图神经网络，可从平衡结构直接预测动力学描述符，例如方向性骨架柔性和成对动态相关性。通过一系列实验，我们表明模型可达到显著更大的集合生成模型的准确度，同时速度快多个数量级，并证明所提出的等变架构特别适合捕捉蛋白质中的各向异性运动。BackFlip-2 模型权重、训练和推理代码可在 https://github.com/graeter-group/backflip 获取。

items.title: Learning from tandem mass spectra at scale with a self-supervised foundation model for proteomics
items.abstract_or_text: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics increasingly relies on machine learning, yet existing models are trained for defined supervised tasks such as peptide identification, de novo sequencing or fragment intensity prediction, limiting transfer across datasets, instruments and acquisition methods. Here we present InstaNovo-FM, a self-supervised foundation model for bottom-up proteomics trained to reconstruct masked regions of tandem mass spectra. We assemble a diverse training corpus spanning 1.63 billion MS/MS spectra and 184.6 million high-confidence annotations. We train an encoder-only transformer on the annotated tier using a physics-aware masked reconstruction objective. We demonstrate that the InstaNovo-FM embeddings encode fundamental experimental and biological properties, including fragmentation method, sequence properties and post-translational modifications, without requiring peptide labels. Furthermore, this foundation model directly enables diverse downstream applications, including de novo peptide sequencing, database-free identification and analytical run classification. InstaNovo-FM establishes a unified representation space for peptide fragmentation spectra, enabling robust transferability across the proteomics ecosystem.
items.summary_zh: InstaNovo-FM 在 16.3 亿条 MS/MS 谱图和 1.846 亿条高置信度注释上预训练，为蛋白质组学谱图提供可迁移的自监督表征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 训练语料规模突出，且任务针对质谱实验数据而非仅序列；预印本报告的下游能力仍需独立复现和跨平台验证。
items.abstract_zh: 基于质谱的蛋白质组学日益依赖机器学习，但现有模型通常针对肽鉴定、从头测序或碎片强度预测等已定义的监督任务训练，从而限制了其在不同数据集、仪器和采集方法之间的迁移。我们在此提出 InstaNovo-FM：一种用于自下而上蛋白质组学的自监督基础模型，通过重建串联质谱中被掩蔽的区域进行训练。我们汇集了一个多样化训练语料库，涵盖 16.3 亿条 MS/MS 谱图和 1.846 亿条高置信度注释。我们使用物理感知的掩蔽重建目标，在注释层级上训练仅编码器 Transformer。我们证明，InstaNovo-FM 嵌入无需肽标签即可编码基本实验和生物学属性，包括碎裂方法、序列属性和翻译后修饰。此外，该基础模型可直接支持多种下游应用，包括从头肽测序、无数据库鉴定和分析运行分类。InstaNovo-FM 为肽碎裂谱建立了统一的表征空间，从而在整个蛋白质组学领域实现稳健的可迁移性。
